name: Refined Gestures
body:
Your puppet mastery affects many foes.

Prerequisite(s): Puppeteer spell-like ability, Sleight of Hand 7 ranks

Benefit(s): You can target multiple creatures with your hypnotic focus by spending a move action each turn to concentrate by continuously gesturing at them. This allows you to control multiple creatures through Puppeteer at the same time, as long as you make all of them take the same actions. When your concentration ends, you may choose one target upon which you maintain your focus. While you control the body of a single creature through Puppeteer, its speed is not penalized, and its movements become lifelike. If you attempt to make it replicate its own mannerisms, use your modifier for Sleight of Hand checks to make a Disguise check, opposed by Sense Motive checks in place of Perception. You may force it to communicate and take actions that require rolls or checks, other than telepathy and purely mental actions. It uses its physical ability scores for its actions, but otherwise uses your bonuses. All above actions you have the target do requires you to concentrate, expending the same actions as it. Roth uses of this feat require somatic components as part of your concentration.
